city_policy: Retain observed cities in candidate preparation; evaluate rare and unseen cities later. No supported prediction-city list is declared.
registration_policy: Optional raw fact. Unknown registration meaning cannot produce a physical-usage claim or a validated registration-gap feature.
training_policy: Use the separately exported source-checked subset for initial exploratory benchmarks. Other candidates remain pending price verification. Fit imputers, encoders, scalers, and rare-category rules inside training folds only.
note: Four observed families and 2010-2026 form the candidate collection/modeling scope. These bounds narrow old and sparse-generation tails; they do not assert market-wide reliability. supported_models remains empty until a trained model and evaluated support contract exist.
